description: This file defines utility functions for creating and resolving runtime environments, including logger-backed runtimes and handling unavailable exit scenarios. It also exports various external modules and types related to runtime configuration and logging.

methods.name: createLoggerBackedRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment that uses a provided logger for output and error handling, with an optional exit error function.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Resolves to an existing runtime environment or creates a new logger-backed runtime if none is provided.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeEnvWithUnavailableExit
methods.description: Resolves a runtime environment that throws an error instead of exiting, indicating that runtime exit is unavailable.
